title: Working on a mobile-first esports manager game in Godot
author: DantalianLazuli
selftext:
Hey everyone,

​I wanted to show off a project I've been making in Godot called MACRO. It's a MOBA esports manager simulator.

​I’ve been focusing heavily on keeping the UI clean and mobile-friendly so the game loop feels smooth on Android. Basically, you play as the GM of an esports org. You have to scout players, deal with fog of war on their actual stats, negotiate their contracts, and try to balance your budget so you don't go broke.

​Getting the financial loop and the player stat generation (tracking stuff like Macro, Mechanics, and Clutch Factor across different seasons) has been a fun challenge to build.

​It's free on itch (HTML5 or Android APK) if anyone wants to test it out. I'd really appreciate any feedback on the UI flow or the simulation balance!

​Link: https://dantalianx.itch.io/macro-esports-manager-simulator

comments.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
comments.body: It would be better if you could pick an esport/game and it would show you pro players within that esport. That would make it feel much more real. Plus, you could have a variety of games and some may be way more simple than others. Take Rocket League for example, all you have to log is goals scored by each team rather than some complex gameplay. I have no attachment to BluePlayer1-5 lol. I also don't understand the game they are playing.
